Name: JP's Wireless Tools
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Wireless Tools[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]
[color=#9900ff][size=5][b][i]Then I discovered that all those years of moving around collecting resources were not necessary at all. 
[/i][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]This mod allows you to use all the tools in wireless mode, just place the cursor where you want the action to start and go full throttle. [/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]By using the K key (configurable) you will start the Wireless mode and you will be able to do everything from the comfort of the corner of the map. [/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]All tools, weapons and mechanics are covered, or so I believe. An extra option to activate a magnetic buff by pressing the key, optional. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list]
[youtube]Gd98OjUnDGU[/youtube]


[color=#ff00ff][size=6][i][u]Translations:[/u][/i][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=4][color=#f4f4f4][/color]If you want, you can make the translation of this mod, [color=#ff0000]no need to ask for permission[/color], and you can publish it on your own in Nexus. [color=#ffff00]This is best because I won't be available to update the translations if you send it to me.[/color] [color=#f4f4f4][/color][/size]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]I will not do the usual translations into Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese either, so you are more than welcome to do translations into these languages. [/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]If you like you can let me know when you have published your translations so that I know you are there.[/size][size=3] [/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=5]Thank you![/size][/color]
[/list][/font]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and move the folder directly to the Mods folder. If you like the mod, click the “Endorse” button at the top of the page ;)

Manifest.Name: (CJP) Wireless Tools
Manifest.Description: Sit on the porch and cut down a tree in the distance.
